plugins.name: active-memory
plugins.description: Switch to a fresh Claude chat without losing a single rule, correction or number. /amhandoff writes a complete handoff file, and a code word plus checkpoints warn you when it is time to switch.

skills.name: amcheckpoint
skills.description: This skill should be used when the user types "/amcheckpoint", or says "recap", "summary so far", "where are we", "are you losing track", "you forgot", "we already decided that", or points out a missing code word. It should also be used without being asked when a chat reaches about 20 or 35 exchanges, when large files or pastes pile up, or when Claude contradicts or forgets something already settled. It writes a compact recap of the chat plus a green, yellow, or red health check.
skills.description_zh: 在长对话回顾、遗忘或前后矛盾时生成简短上下文摘要，并给出绿、黄、红健康状态；支持 /amcheckpoint，作者也建议在约 20 或 35 次交互及大量文件累积时检查。

skills.name: amcodeword
skills.description: This skill should be used when the user types "/amcodeword", "/amcodeword off", "/amcodeword status", "/amcodeword" with a phrase after it, or asks to "set a code word", "start every reply with", "turn on the code word", or "turn off the code word". It makes Claude open every reply with a fixed phrase (default "Yes Boss!") so the user can spot the moment Claude starts losing track of a long chat: the phrase goes missing.
headings: When the user reports a missing code word
skills.description_zh: 通过 /amcodeword 设置、关闭或查询固定回复开头短语（默认 Yes Boss!），以短语是否消失作为长对话上下文遗失的观察信号。

skills.name: amhandoff
skills.description: This skill should be used when the user types "/amhandoff", or asks to "move to a new chat", "continue in a new chat", "make a handoff file", "save this chat so I can continue later", "export the context", or when a checkpoint is red or the code word went missing. It reads the whole chat in four passes and writes a complete handoff.md so a fresh chat is fully up to speed from its first reply. It should also be used when a user attaches or pastes a file that starts with "# active-memory handoff".
headings: 2. About the user (as relevant to this work)
skills.description_zh: 用于迁移到新对话或保存上下文，分四遍阅读对话并生成完整 handoff.md；也可处理 active-memory handoff 文件，并在检查为红色或暗号丢失时准备交接。

skills.name: amhelp
skills.description: This skill should be used when the user types "/amhelp", or asks "what does active-memory do", "how do I use active-memory", "what are the active-memory commands", or "help with amcodeword / amcheckpoint / amhandoff / amsetup". It shows a short guide to every active-memory command plus one tip tailored to the current chat.
skills.description_zh: 展示 active-memory 各命令的简短使用指南，并提供针对当前对话的一条建议，适用于 /amhelp 和相关命令帮助请求。

skills.name: amsetup
skills.description: This skill should be used when the user types "/amsetup", or says "active-memory isn't working", "the hooks don't run", "python3 is not recognized", "it opens the Microsoft Store", "set up active-memory", or reports an error coming from the plugin. It checks what active-memory needs on this machine, explains what works without Python, and offers to install Python with the user's approval.
headings: Step 2: if no Python is installed
skills.description_zh: 诊断 active-memory 插件环境、钩子和 Python 问题，说明无需 Python 的可用功能；需要安装 Python 时按作者流程先征求用户同意。
